# Effortless

> Effortless is the All-In-One Growth Platform for Indian SMBs — automating billing, expenses, sales operations, contracts, and cash flow management.

## About

Effortless is a B2B SaaS platform built for fast-growing Indian businesses with field sales teams, multi-branch operations, or distribution networks. It replaces fragmented tools (spreadsheets, legacy software) with a single platform covering order-to-cash, expense management, field sales tracking, compliance, and banking visibility.

Founded by Chartered Accountants and backed by deep domain expertise, Effortless is trusted by 1,000+ businesses across India with offices in Chennai, Bangalore, Mumbai, and Hyderabad.

## Core Products

- **Effortless Sales**: Field sales tracking, order-to-cash automation, scheme management, GPS check-ins, fleet-on-street selling
- **Effortless Expenses**: AI-powered bill booking, expense claims, reimbursements, petty cash management, policy-based approvals
- **Effortless Contracts**: Contracts & billing automation, recurring invoicing, GST e-invoicing, e-way bills, buyer portal

## Key Features

- Tally Integration (concurrent & bi-directional)
- GST & TDS Compliance
- Business Health Dashboard
- WhatsApp Alerts & Reports
- Banking & Cash Flow Visibility
- Role-Based Access Control
- Enterprise-Grade Security (8 levels)
- Multi-level Approvals

## Pricing

- **Premium Pro**: Starting at INR 30,000/month (billed annually), up to 50 users, includes geo-fencing, fraud prevention, biometric integration, buyer portal, dedicated support
- **Premium**: Starting at INR 12,833/month (billed annually), up to 15 users, includes Tally integration, e-invoicing, expense management, GPS tracking
